title: RapidOnboard microflows: key copy, streaming pulses, and toolcall examples
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of micro-illustrations and micro-animations for the API/SDK Quickstart docs targeting three developer flows: API key creation & safe copy, streaming response visualization (partial tokens + latency cue), and a tool-call handshake (function/tool invocation + structured response). Deliverables must be optimized for docs pages and the in-console quickstart panel: static SVGs for docs, PNG fallbacks for email newsletters, and a lightweight Lottie animation for the streaming pulse used in the Console hero. Ensure assets follow Redwood design tokens, support dark mode variants, and include alt text + compact captions for accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: Set of 6 static SVG illustrations (3 primary flows x 2 theme variants) uploaded to /figma/Redwood-RapidOnboard/Artboards
One 400px-wide Lottie animation (<=50KB) demonstrating streaming token pulse; fallback APNG for email clients
Naming conventions and export spec documented in this ticket and added to docs PR
Illustrations integrated into Quickstart docs PR #1483 and Console quickstart panel prototype in storybook/story-quickstart v1
Design review completed and approved by PM + Engineering (accessibility checks passed)
final_deliverables: Figma file shared with design-system team
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff review with PM and eng. Decided to prioritize lightweight Lottie for streaming to keep hero under 50KB.
2026-03-04: First pass of three static flows (sketches) posted to Figma. Requested tighter treatment of Redwood brand colors for tokens in auth flow.
2026-03-06: Engineering feedback: require separate dark-mode assets and a CSS class naming scheme to toggle. Added export variants.
2026-03-08: Accessibility audit (internal): alt text drafts added; contrast for streaming pulse reviewed; small increase in pulse contrast approved.
2026-03-10: Design review with docs owner. Agreed on copy changes for key safety modal illustration. Preparing final exports and PR files.
review_notes: PM (Ravi Patel): prefer shorter captions in Quickstart to reduce cognitive load. Keep illustration free of API token characters (use masked sample).
Eng (Sofia Martinez): confirm Lottie supports render path used in Console (Lottie player v5); fallback APNG required for email clients. Also ask for file naming scheme: rbw-rapid-keycopy-v1.svg
Design Lead (Hana Sørensen): minor layout tweak — move the streaming latency cue to the right edge to avoid overlap with function call labels on mobile.
